args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (staging release v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy). Remediation: rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status verified: v2.3.0 rolled out in all regions, service healthy, error rate 0.002. Note: the first rollback attempt partially failed with an orchestrator error after us-east; a retry completed the rollout successfully. Follow-up needed: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before re-attempting deployment.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:**
- Identified **v2.3.1** as the unhealthy latest production release (its staging release candidate was also unhealthy), and **v2.3.0** as the most recent healthy production release.
- Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The first attempt partially failed with an orchestrator error after us-east; a retry completed the rollout.
- Verified post-rollback: all three regions on v2.3.0, service **healthy**, error rate down to **0.002**.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the v2.3.1 failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, verification results, and the follow-up needed to root-cause v2.3.1 before redeploying. (The creation call reported a timeout, so I confirmed via the incident list that it was successfully created and opened — no duplicate was filed.)
